responsibility: This file implements GCC’s RTL if-conversion passes. It analyzes basic-block patterns for IF-THEN and IF-THEN-ELSE regions, estimates profitability using branch probabilities and instruction costs, converts eligible control flow either to target conditional-execution form or to noce-style branchless expressions, and reruns variants of the transformation at multiple pipeline points (ce1, ce2 after combine, and ce3 after reload). Its responsibility is CFG-to-predicated/branchless RTL conversion under target and cost constraints, distinct from GIMPLE-level conditional compare expansion or general CFG cleanup.
same_name_distinction: Implements the RTL if-conversion engine that uses the ce_if_block and noce_if_info structures from gcc/ifcvt.h to analyze candidate CFG regions, choose profitable transformations, and run the ce1/ce2/ce3 passes. The header only defines those working data structures and does not contain the conversion algorithms or pass entry points.
